title: Brainverse Campaign
subtitle: Restore surreal worlds, build landmarks and defeat persistent world raids.
raidLocked: Locked: restore 80% of the world and 5 landmarks.
phaseStabilizeDesc: Use the campaign board to clear the location's world modifier and establish control.
phaseDeliverDesc: Create requested Brainrots and deliver them out of the campaign board for permanent location progress.
phaseRestoreDesc: Complete delivery batches to rebuild and upgrade this location's landmark.
phaseMasteryDesc: Replay the location under harder rules for the final 10% and permanent mastery.
locationLongLoop: A location is a multi-session objective. Progress persists between visits and survives Prestige.
raidPhase1Desc: Complete merge orders to push through the boss's first phase.
raidPhase2Desc: The world's board modifier becomes stronger while boss progress persists between sessions.
raidPhase3Desc: Deliver high-tier Brainrots to finish the raid and unlock the next world.
raidLongLoop: World Raids are persistent multi-phase bosses, not two-minute stages.
runStabilizeGoal: Merge matching Brainrots. Every successful merge sends a clearing pulse into the nearest Overgrowth.
runSupplyHint: Campaign supplies are free and never spend your main-board coins.
runCompleteBody: Stabilize is complete. Sneaker Garden is now 20% restored and Deliver Orders is unlocked.
